name: Gath Rimmon
overview: Gath Rimmon is identified in Scripture as a Levitical city connected primarily to the tribe of Dan, as noted alongside other cities in Joshua 19:45 and Joshua 21:24. Additionally, it is associated with the half tribe of Manasseh, where it is sometimes called Bileam, highlighting its significance within tribal allotments and Levitical assignments. The references emphasize its role as a city with suburbs, underscoring its established place within the tribal and Levitical landscape of Israel.
